mission: Create an elite isolated training and certification environment where DreamCo bots learn, practice, fail safely, compete, improve, and graduate only after reproducible evidence proves they can perform their assigned capabilities under realistic conditions.
name: Buddy Bootcamp
applies_to: every canonical DreamCo bot, builder bot, coding bot, specialist, model route, and user-created bot eligible for training
principles: train on representative work, not toy demos only
benchmark before and after every major curriculum stage
shared improvements are promoted to fleet infrastructure
no production write or external side effect from training without explicit authorized test adapter
graduation requires evidence, not time spent
user-created bots can train through the same evidence standards

sandbox_layers.purpose: Linting, schema checks, type checks, dependency/license/security analysis, contract validation and prompt/policy review without execution.
Deterministic unit and skill fixtures with synthetic/local data.
Mocked APIs, databases, queues, files, tools and adapters with failure injection.
Simulated customers, users, business workflows, games, devices, content pipelines, coding repos and professional tasks.
Edge cases, malformed inputs, prompt injection, confusing requirements, timeout, rate-limit, stale-data and hostile-but-contained scenarios.
Latency, throughput, concurrency, memory, storage, network, token, cost and energy-relevant benchmarks.
Top-30 competitor/substitute and open-source/vibe-coding same-fixture comparisons where lawful and available.
Authenticated non-production adapters and realistic staging flows with audit receipts and rollback.
Final mixed scenario exam covering correctness, recovery, user effort, quality, safety, privacy, rights and domain benchmarks.

isolation_and_resource_controls.filesystem: ephemeral workspace by default with explicit mounted fixtures

curriculum_levels.goal: Identity, mission, boundaries, canonical owner, inputs/outputs and user promise are correct.
Core capabilities pass deterministic fixtures and the bot understands failure modes.
Domain-specific hard cases, professional workflows, libraries, tools and data packages pass.
Multi-step workflows, adapters, retries, state, memory, permissions and recovery pass.
Bot runs same-fixture comparisons against current competitors/open-source baselines and closes measured gaps.
Bot handles difficult mixed workloads efficiently, safely and with low user effort.
Bot can teach reusable lessons, generate fixtures and promote shared improvements without creating duplicate systems.
Release definition of done, domain benchmarks, guardrails, security/privacy and production observation requirements are satisfied.

training_drills: ambiguous request clarification without unnecessary friction
bad data and corrupt file handling

bootcamp_teams.role: Select curriculum, enforce evidence gates and prevent skipping hard requirements.
Turn failures into bounded practice tasks and explain the shortest route to improvement.
Generate deterministic, domain and edge-case fixtures.
Challenge assumptions, security, privacy, prompt injection, edge cases and failure handling inside the sandbox.
Run identical before/after and competitor fixtures and preserve results.
Profile latency, cost, CPU, memory, storage, network and concurrency.
Review maintainability, duplication, interfaces, tests and upgrade quality.
Run data-package quality, provenance, contamination, privacy and usefulness tests.
Verify current coding libraries/techniques and teach exact-version reusable skill cards.
Aggregate evidence and approve training status; it cannot waive global guardrails.

bot_scorecard.rule: No score can hide failed, blocked, skipped or unmeasured required gates.

data_package_track.graduation: A sellable package cannot graduate from Bootcamp until applicable sellable_verified gates pass.

promotion_and_shared_learning: record every verified improvement with baseline and after result
check whether the improvement is reusable
promote reusable improvements to shared canonical infrastructure
keep domain-only improvement as an extension rather than duplicating shared code
store failure lessons and new fixtures for future recruits
graduation_rules: required benchmark targets pass or valid documented exception exists
no unnecessary duplicate implementation is introduced
human review occurs where repository policy requires it
production-ready label requires actual deployment/production observation evidence
user_created_bot_flow: train or modify bot in isolated workspace
export bot, skill pack, evaluation card and provenance record
truth_rule: Buddy Bootcamp is a training, testing and certification architecture. A config or passing static check alone is not proof that a full sandbox runner, container isolation, staging adapters or every curriculum drill is already operational. Runtime capabilities must be verified separately.
